preconditions.description: The number of rows in the flag matrix is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of columns in the flag matrix and the number of segments are each between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the flag matrix is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.
The segment borders l and r are within the range of the number of columns in the flag matrix.

postconditions.expression: output_line == beauty_of_segment(flag_matrix, l, r) for each segment
postconditions.description: The output for each segment is the beauty of the corresponding segment of the flag matrix.
